title: Implement session lifecycle: accept to handshake to command loop to teardown
description:
Implement the full per-connection async task: (1) send 200/201 greeting, (2) STARTTLS upgrade if client requests it, (3) AUTHINFO handshake if auth_required, (4) command loop (read line, parse, dispatch, write response, repeat), (5) teardown on QUIT or connection close, (6) update session metrics on close. Artifact: reader/src/session/lifecycle.rs.

Acceptance: connection enters command loop after successful handshake; QUIT sends 205 and closes; abrupt client disconnect is handled cleanly (no panic); per-session span in tracing includes peer_addr and session duration
